card.name: Dosing frequency words like every, once
card.fires_on: The word right after a dosing-frequency phrase, such as "every" or "once", where an interval or count follows ("every 4 hours", "once per day").

modes.label: Maximum frequency
modes.description: "once" or "every" after a phrase about the maximum dosing frequency.
modes.example: The maximum recommended dosing frequency is<< once>> per day.

modes.label: Interval limits
modes.description: "every" after "more frequently than" or "increased to" before a number of days or hours.
modes.example: with dose increases no more frequent than<< every>> 3 to 5 days.

card.writes: It seems to push the model to continue with a time interval, though the promoted tokens are mixed and not clearly related.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "every" or "once" when a label says how often a dose can be given.
